change.summary: Key-only layout reproduced from the versioned GitHub controls snapshot, excluding bindings for the retired Backpacked and TrashSlot mods; forced exactly once per client profile for the 2026-10-28 release migration.

modifiers.before: Native defaults and user key_ rows; no JEM preset consumer.
modifiers.after: Only real registered actions are applied from source-owned curated key map; no non-key profile settings. Existing profiles require /jemkeys preview/apply. Separate local receipt prevents update resets.
Apply newly added default bindings on the next managed-client generation only where the player has not customized that binding; retire TrashSlot and old backpack bindings.

modifiers.before: The embedded preset had later curated deviations from the checked-in original-controls snapshot.
modifiers.after: The embedded preset is mechanically rebuilt from Docs/releases/2026-10-26-original-controls-development-inventory/original-keybinds.txt. Only Backpacked and TrashSlot actions are omitted because those mods are no longer installed.

modifiers.before: Existing profiles with an older receipt would not automatically consume a replaced embedded preset.
modifiers.after: Every client profile applies the GitHub-derived preset once when its versioned 2026-10-28 receipt is absent. The receipt lives inside that profile, so test jem cannot consume the future JustEnoughMods/friend migration, and later launches or AutoModpack generations preserve player edits.

rationale.purpose: Preserve the user key map while keeping primary race/map actions accessible.
rationale.decision_source: User2026-10-20 shipping/economy full handoff tasks8/13 and explicit compass investigation; concrete adapter choices by Codex.
